# Project Scaffold Templates

This directory contains clone-ready scaffold repositories.

## Taxonomy

- **Project scaffolds**: multi-file starters that include `.github/` workflows and repository contracts.
- **File templates**: single-file copy/paste starters in `docs/templates/`.
- **Examples**: read-only references in `docs/examples/`.

## Current scaffolds

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `basecoat-memory/` | Starter repository structure for organization shared memory |
| `repo-template/` | Starter repository template with Base Coat lock/enforcement workflows |
